transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Um. Nice to meet you too. I guess... things just got kind of out of hand lately. 

I'm usually just a normal crew guy on a landscaping team, but... I don't know. I just started trying to run three different bids at once. I was calling city people, trying to line up plant suppliers... messaging everybody I knew about this park idea I had. 

Just... I couldn't shut it off. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Have you been hearing or seeing things that other people don’t seem to?
No... um. Nothing like that. Just... no.
Have you ever had a period when you felt very down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks?
Um... I don't really know. I guess I get down sometimes, like anybody. I don't really keep track of how many weeks it is or whatever.
Did this high-energy period lead to you being hospitalized?
No. I didn't go to a hospital or anything. I just... ended up coming here.
Did this high-energy period cause serious problems at work or in your relationships?
No, not really. I mean, maybe some arguments here and there, but... nothing serious. Just normal stuff, I think.
About how many days in a row did this high-energy period last?

Um... maybe about two weeks? I guess it started when I was trying to put together this pitch for a park job. I got pretty fired up about it. But yeah... it lasted around two weeks. And then I just crashed.
During that two-week high-energy period, did you need much less sleep than usual and still feel full of energy?
No... not really. I mean, I guess I slept about the same as usual. I didn't really notice a difference.
During that two-week period, did you feel unusually confident or like you had special abilities or ideas that other people didn’t recognize?

Yeah... I guess so. Um... I kind of got it in my head that I was about to be, like, the main guy every town around here called for sustainable landscaping. I just felt like I had it all figured out... even though, you know, I'm really just trying to keep my small jobs paid up. But yeah... I felt pretty sure of it then.
Have you ever had a time when you felt depressed or lost interest in things nearly every day for at least two weeks?
Um... I don't know. Not really, I guess. I mean... I have bad days like anyone else, but... I wouldn't say for two weeks straight. I usually just try to keep working.
During that two-week period, were you talking a lot more than usual?
Um... no. I don't think so. I mostly just work by myself anyway, so... yeah, I didn't really notice anything like that. I'm usually pretty quiet.
During that two-week period, were you much more driven than usual to start or take on projects?

Um... yeah, I suppose so. I was... doing a lot. I'd be up way before daylight, just... loading my tools, sketching out garden beds... looking up prices for native plants. And then, I don't know, even after a full day outside working, I just... I still felt like I had to keep going. But... yeah.
During that two-week period, were you more active and taking on more work or projects than you normally do?

Yeah... I guess. I mean, usually I'm just a regular crew guy. But... I started trying to run three bids at once. Calling the city... lining up suppliers. I was messaging everybody I knew about this park idea. It was just... I don't know. Like I couldn't shut it off, I guess.
During that two-week period, did your thoughts feel like they were racing?

Um... yeah. I guess. My head was just... running really fast. Just all these... plant lists, and... slogans. Park layouts. I kept thinking about who I needed to impress to make it happen. I'd just sit there and fill up pages in this notebook, but... I don't know, I still felt like I was behind. So... yeah.
During that two-week period, were you much more active and taking on more work or projects than you normally do?
Um... didn't you just ask me that? But... yeah. Like I said before, I was doing a lot more than I usually do. With the bids and everything. I don't really know what else to tell you.
During that two-week period, did you do anything unusually risky or impulsive for you?

Um... I guess so. I mean... I put a bunch of stuff on my credit card. Just... new tools, plants... some work clothes. I even paid for some ads. I just acted like the money was already coming in. Now... I don't know. I look at the balance and I just feel sick. I can't cover it.
During that two-week period, did other people notice that you were acting differently than usual?
Um... I don't really know. I mostly just work by myself anyway. If anybody thought something was up... they didn't say it to me. So... I guess not.
During that two-week period, did you feel unusually happy or euphoric?

Um... I don't know about happy. I just felt... fired up, I guess. Like I could take on anything. But... I was also pretty on edge. Like, if one of the guys at work questioned what I was doing or told me to slow down... I'd just snap at them. Way harder than I should have. So... yeah. Not really happy. Just... intense, I guess.
During that two-week period, did your spending on the credit card cause a serious financial problem for you?
Um... I don't know about serious. Like I said, I can't pay it all off right now, but... I'll just try to pick up some extra yards or something. I'll figure it out.
Did people who know you well clearly notice that you were acting differently than usual during that time?
Um... like I said before... I mostly keep to myself. So... I don't really know if anyone noticed. They didn't tell me if they did.
During that two-week period, were you still able to do your regular work responsibilities as usual?
Um... yeah. I still went to work. Got everything done. I mean, I was moving pretty fast, so... I probably got more done than usual, to be honest. But yeah, I did my job.
